title: Keyturn Host Protection Plan: Cover Limits and Sublimits by Plan
content:
Each plan of the Keyturn Host Protection Plan carries an overall ceiling on damage to the host's own vehicle and a separate ceiling on third-party liability, and within the physical damage ceiling it carries its own ceiling for each kind of loss.

### Overall ceilings

| Plan | Physical damage limit, USD | Third-party liability limit, USD |
|---|---|---|
| Keyturn Shield 90 Host Plan | 45000 | 50000 |
| Keyturn Shield 85 Host Plan | 70000 | 100000 |
| Keyturn Shield 80 Host Plan | 100000 | 250000 |
| Keyturn Shield 75 Host Plan | 150000 | 500000 |
| Keyturn Shield 70 Host Plan | 200000 | 750000 |
| Keyturn Shield 60 Host Plan | 300000 | 1000000 |

### Ceilings for each kind of loss

| Plan | Body and paint, USD | Interior, USD | Glass, USD | Tyres and wheels, USD | Missing equipment, USD | Third-party property, USD |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Keyturn Shield 90 Host Plan | 12000 | 2500 | 750 | 600 | 500 | 25000 |
| Keyturn Shield 85 Host Plan | 18000 | 3500 | 1000 | 900 | 750 | 50000 |
| Keyturn Shield 80 Host Plan | 26000 | 5000 | 1500 | 1200 | 1000 | 100000 |
| Keyturn Shield 75 Host Plan | 40000 | 7500 | 2000 | 1800 | 1500 | 250000 |
| Keyturn Shield 70 Host Plan | 60000 | 10000 | 3000 | 2500 | 2500 | 500000 |
| Keyturn Shield 60 Host Plan | 90000 | 15000 | 4500 | 4000 | 4000 | 750000 |

### Notes

The body and paint ceiling is the largest of the ceilings for a kind of loss on every plan, running from 12000 on the Keyturn Shield 90 Host Plan to 90000 on the Keyturn Shield 60 Host Plan. Glass and tyres and wheels carry the smallest ceilings, 750 and 600 respectively on the Keyturn Shield 90 Host Plan. The third-party property ceiling sits inside the third-party liability limit and is published separately from it: on the Keyturn Shield 80 Host Plan the liability limit is 250000 while the third-party property ceiling is 100000.
